title: Orlicz-Sobolev with Musielak: An Efficient Regularization Approach for Graph-based IPM
abstract: arXiv:2510.25591v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the Sobolev IPM problem for probability measures supported on a graph metric space, where critic function is constrained to lie within the unit ball defined by Sobolev norm. Sobolev IPM is intrinsically coupled with $L^p$ geometric structure within its definition, limiting its ability to incorporate other prior geometry beyond the $L^p$ paradigm. Conversely, the classic optimal transport is flexible, easy to adapt to various geometric structures by simply changing its ground cost. An important example is Orlicz-Wasserstein (OW) which utilizes \emph{Orlicz} geometric structure to generalize the $L^p$ within the standard $p$-order Wasserstein, and remarkably play a vital role to advance machine learning methodologies. translated_title: 基于Musielak的Orlicz-Sobolev：一种面向图上IPM的高效正则化方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了支撑在图度量空间上的概率测度的Sobolev IPM（积分概率度量）问题，其中评判函数（critic function）被约束在由Sobolev范数定义的单位球内。Sobolev IPM在其定义中本质上与 $L^p$ 几何结构耦合，这限制了它融入 $L^p$ 范式之外其他先验几何结构的能力。相反，经典的最优传输是灵活的，只需简单地改变其基础代价（ground cost）便能适应各种几何结构。一个重要的例子是Orlicz-Wasserstein（OW），它利用Orlicz几何结构对标准 $p$ 阶Wasserstein中的 $L^p$ 进行了推广，并在推动机器学习方法发展方面发挥了重要作用。受OW最新进展的启发，在本工作中，我们利用一类特定的凸函数来构造Orlicz几何，以缓解Sobolev IPM的上述局限性，并提出了广义Sobolev IPM（
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Orlicz几何的广义Sobolev IPM方法，通过引入一类特定凸函数突破了传统Sobolev IPM受限于L^p几何结构的局限，为基于图的积分概率度量提供了高效的正则化途径。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generalized Sobolev IPM that leverages Orlicz geometry through a specific class of convex functions, overcoming the inherent L^p geometric limitations of standard Sobolev IPM and providing an efficient regularization approach for graph-based integral probability metrics.
